q: The Local Hamiltonian Problem (deciding if the ground state energy is ≤a or ≥b) is QMA-complete. This means:
opts: It is solvable in polynomial quantum time
It is the quantum analogue of 3-SAT — hard for quantum computers to verify and solve
exp: Kitaev (1999): k-Local Hamiltonian is QMA-complete — it is 'quantum NP-complete'. Quantum witnesses (quantum states) allow verification in quantum polynomial time, but no efficient quantum algorithm is known. This is the quantum computational complexity version of finding ground states.
